in_sanskrit.name: Monju
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Wisdom
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Monju एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Monju is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'manas' meaning 'mind' and 'jna' meaning 'knowledge'. It is the name of the God of Wisdom in Hindu mythology. Monju is often invoked to enhance wisdom, intelligence, and knowledge.
